title: Tournament
description: This is a Simple to use Tournament plugin for local use that is for a pvp tournament where it tracks kills, Spectating and more!
body:
This is a localized tournament plugin with the idea that you host it on your computer and have all your friends connect to do pvp. it has a couple of simple commands, spectating and more.  commands list:
/starttournament -- starts the ten minute tournament timer
/endtournament -- cancels/ends the tournament
/spectate -- there are a number of spectating commands where you can spectate the leader, or randomly spectate players. this is only for admins and such.
